definitions.explanation: The percentage of people who support or approve of a political leader, party, or policy. A key metric in political polling and news reporting.

examples.japanese: {内閣|ないかく}{支持率|しじりつ}が{下|さ}がった。
{最新|さいしん}の{世論調査|よろんちょうさ}で{支持率|しじりつ}は30%だった。
examples.english: In the latest public opinion poll, the approval rating was 30%.

examples.japanese: {政権|せいけん}の{支持率|しじりつ}が{急落|きゅうらく}したため、{首相|しゅしょう}は{内閣改造|ないかくかいぞう}に{踏|ふ}み{切|き}った。
examples.english: Because the administration's approval rating plummeted, the prime minister decided on a cabinet reshuffle.

notes:
USAGE:
A staple of Japanese political news. NHK, major newspapers, and other media regularly publish {内閣|ないかく}{支持率|しじりつ} surveys. Also used for political parties and individual politicians.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内閣|ないかく}{支持率|しじりつ} (cabinet approval rating)
- {政党|せいとう}{支持率|しじりつ} (party support rate)
- {支持率|しじりつ}が{上|あ}がる/{下|さ}がる (approval rating goes up/down)
- {支持率|しじりつ}{調査|ちょうさ} (approval rating survey)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不支持率|ふしじりつ}: disapproval rating — the opposite metric, often reported alongside
- {投票率|とうひょうりつ}: voter turnout — the percentage of eligible voters who actually voted
